description: Header file defining the WebSockHttpFlexServer class, which implements a combined WebSocket and HTTP server supporting both plain and SSL connections, based on Boost.Beast library. It includes class declarations, private members, and method signatures related to server initialization, request handling, and listener management.

classes.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer
classes.description: A class implementing a combined WebSocket and HTTP server with support for SSL, based on Boost.Beast, providing methods for initialization, starting the server, and managing listeners.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server with a logger utility.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the server with host, port, certificate path, and security mode.

methods.description: Registers a listener for server events.
